headline: RapWire 24/7: Don Toliver, Kyivstoner, Havoc, Travis Scott and GTA VI
caption:
1) Don Toliver’s Manchester concert was evacuated on Nov. 22 after an unknown substance spread through Co-op Live. More than 12,000 fans were escorted out, over 80 people were treated by medics, and police said the cause remains under investigation. @dontoliver
2) Authorities in Poland say rapper Kyivstoner, Albert Vasiliev, was allegedly targeted in a Warsaw plot in August after Denmark disclosed a separate suspected Russian-backed plan near Copenhagen. The dual Ukrainian-American artist was not harmed, and officials’ allegations are still being investigated. @kyivstoner
3) Prodigy’s estate sued Havoc and his companies, alleging it was denied shares from at least 172 Mobb Deep shows and more than $1 million in merchandise sales since 2017. Havoc answered publicly that he hopes the dispute can be settled amicably, while the court case seeks records, damages and Prodigy’s masters. @therealhavoc
4) Travis Scott’s Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1 collection is getting another drop on Nov. 23 through cactusjack.com after the white and black pairs launched through SNKRS and select retailers. The crossover turns GTA VI’s launch into a streetwear release, with the shoes listed at a $130 retail price. @travisscott
5) Rockstar says darts and bowling were left out of GTA VI because the team did not get to darts and would rather omit activities than ship them below standard. Players have also found Leonida’s casinos and go-kart track closed after the story, reinforcing the game’s choice to favor narrative fit and polish. @rockstargames

@Rapwire247
